headline: El Niño will drain momentum from the Peruvian economy
summary: Peru's Economy Ministry projects 3.1% GDP growth for the year, below the 3.4% previously forecast, as El Niño weighs on activity, according to its 2027–2031 macroeconomic update.
why: Peru is a major copper, gold and zinc producer, and its growth and fiscal outlook affect mining investment and sol-denominated assets.
original_headline: El Niño quitará dinamismo a economía peruana
